- This project must be developed using the Python programming language, specifically version 3.10 or higher. Ensure that all code is compatible with this version to leverage the latest features and improvements in the language.
- The primary GUI framework to be used for this project is pyside6. All graphical user interface components, including windows, dialogs, and widgets, must be implemented using this framework to ensure consistency and compatibility across the application.
- The project must be compatible with Windows, Linux, and macOS operating systems. Ensure that all code, dependencies, and configurations are tested and verified to work seamlessly across these platforms.
